svg.title: vLLM request flow: from HTTP to GPU and back
svg.desc: Sequence of one chat request with numbered steps. The client posts HTTP to FastAPI, which tokenizes and calls AsyncLLM generate. AsyncLLM sends an ADD over ZMQ to EngineCore. Every step until the request finishes, the scheduler sends work to the worker, the worker runs forward and sampling and returns token IDs, EngineCore sends outputs over ZMQ, AsyncLLM detokenizes, and FastAPI sends SSE or JSON to the client. When the request ends, EngineCore frees its KV blocks.
